# Operations & Deployment Checklist: SpamDetector API

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review ("unit tests for English") for operational, hosting,
configuration, and observability requirements of the Azure Functions deployment.
**Created**: 2026-09-12
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer (here, the author pre-commit) determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Scope**: Operational / deployment domain — Azure Functions hosting, configuration, observability. Depth: Standard. Audience: Author (pre-commit).

## Hosting & Runtime Requirements

- [ ] CHK001 Are the Azure Functions hosting plan requirements (Consumption / Flex Consumption / Premium / Dedicated) specified, given the low-latency success criteria? [Completeness, Gap]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the required Functions runtime host version and worker model (v4 isolated, .NET 10) stated as a requirement rather than only an implementation note? [Clarity, Plan Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK003 Are cold-start behavior requirements addressed and reconciled with the latency goals? [Coverage, Gap, Plan Performance Goals]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the HTTP trigger authorization level (anonymous vs function/admin key) explicitly specified as a requirement? [Completeness, Gap]
- [ ] CHK005 Are the horizontal scaling / statelessness expectations (no shared state across instances) documented as requirements? [Consistency, Spec §FR-018, Plan Scale/Scope]
- [ ] CHK006 Are per-instance concurrency or throttling expectations specified, or intentionally left to platform defaults? [Coverage, Gap]

## Configuration Requirements

- [ ] CHK007 Are all tunable operational values (max request body size, OpenAI timeout, default model) enumerated as configuration requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, §FR-005, §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the default max request body size (1,048,576 bytes / 1 MB) stated unambiguously and marked configurable? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the configuration source and precedence (Azure App Settings vs `appsettings.json` vs `local.settings.json`) specified for each tunable value? [Clarity, Gap]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the behavior specified when a configuration value is missing, empty, or invalid at startup? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK011 Are the units and bounds for the configurable timeout (30 seconds) defined and consistent between spec and plan? [Consistency, Spec §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK012 Is there a requirement that the host request-size limit and the in-handler body-size check remain consistent (no divergent limits)? [Consistency, Gap, Plan Constraints]

## Secrets & Data Handling in Operations

- [ ] CHK013 Is it specified that the BYOK key arrives only via the request header and is never sourced from app settings or environment configuration? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK014 Are requirements defined ensuring the BYOK key is excluded from all deployment-time and runtime configuration stores? [Completeness, Spec §II BYOK Isolation]
- [ ] CHK015 Is a requirement stated that `local.settings.json` and any secret-bearing config are excluded from source control? [Gap, Assumption]
- [ ] CHK016 Are data-residency / cross-border requirements addressed for email content transmitted to the external provider? [Coverage, Gap]

## Observability & Logging Requirements

- [ ] CHK017 Are logging requirements defined for the specific categories (request-processing failures, provider status/error categories, elapsed classification time)? [Completeness, Plan Constraints]
- [ ] CHK018 Are the log-content prohibitions (API key, credentials, full email body, raw provider payloads) stated as explicit, testable requirements? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015, §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK019 Do the telemetry/observability requirements (e.g., Application Insights) explicitly reconcile with the "credential never in telemetry" constraint? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015, §II]
- [ ] CHK020 Are required log levels / structured-logging fields defined so operational logs are objectively verifiable? [Measurability, Gap]
- [ ] CHK021 Are requirements defined for excluding personally identifiable email content from normal logs and traces? [Coverage, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK022 Is a correlation/trace identifier requirement specified for diagnosing a single request without exposing content? [Gap]

## Timeout, Cancellation & Resilience (Operational)

- [ ] CHK023 Is the interaction between the 30-second OpenAI timeout and the Functions host `functionTimeout` specified so the host does not abort before the controlled 502 is returned? [Conflict, Gap, Spec §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK024 Are cancellation-propagation requirements (client disconnect → downstream cancellation) defined at the operational boundary? [Coverage, Spec §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK025 Is the "no automatic retries initially" decision stated as a requirement, with conditions under which retries would later be permitted? [Clarity, Plan Research §8]

## Deployment & Environment Requirements

- [ ] CHK026 Are deployment mechanism and environment requirements (how the Function app is provisioned/published) documented or explicitly out of scope? [Completeness, Gap]
- [ ] CHK027 Are health/readiness or availability-monitoring requirements defined, or intentionally excluded for this stateless service? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK028 Are the status-code-to-`ApiResult.HttpCode` consistency requirements verifiable in the deployed hosting model (413/500/502 not overridden by the platform)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-014, §SC-008]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Items marked `[Gap]` indicate operational requirements that appear undocumented; resolve by adding to spec/plan or explicitly scoping out
